name: Mitsuki Okami
source: A sixth-year from House Cairngorm. It isn't just Mitsuki’s name and Japanese origin that makes her stand out. She prefers to spend her time alone and doesn't really have any friends. During her years at Tír na nÓg she earned herself a reputation of a 'lone wolf'.
translation: A sixth-year from House Cairngorm. It isn't just Mitsuki’s name and Japanese origin that makes her stand out. She prefers to spend her time alone and doesn't really have any friends. During her years at Tír na nÓg she earned herself a reputation of a 'lone wolf'.
